mapper.select: SELECT p.ID AS id, p.PHARMACY_NAME AS pharmacyName, p.LATITUDE AS latitude, p.LONGITUDE AS longitude, p.PHONE AS phone, p.ADDRESS AS address, nb.TITLE AS title, nb.CONTENT AS content FROM PHARMACY p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY b.PHARMACY_ID ORDER BY b.UPDATED_AT DESC, b.ID DESC ) rn FROM PHARMACY_BOARD b ) nb ON nb.PHARMACY_ID = p.ID AND nb.rn = 1 WHERE p.LATITUDE BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat} AND p.LONGITUDE BETWEEN #{minLon} AND #{maxLon}
